title: XG's OptiQoL
description: XG's OptiQoL (pronounced like "optical") aims to provide the optimization factor of the Simply Optimized modpack by forking it while also adding some quality of life mods to enhance your experience in-game in other ways.
body:
XG's OptiQoL (pronounced like "optical") aims to provide the optimization factor of the [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) modpack by forking it while also adding some quality of life mods to enhance your experience in-game in other ways.  
  
OptiQoL is built off of the base of Simply Optimized, the leading optimization modpack, but adds to the experience of optimized performance with extra, mostly vanilla-feeling addins. When all mods update to the newest version, we do too.
